[IALC.5.2] An override must supply a coherent matched set —
`{malloc, calloc, realloc, free, strdup, strndup}` from one allocator.
Overriding `ds_malloc` without `ds_free` is a cross-allocator free; an
override lacking native `strdup`/`strndup` must implement them over its
own `malloc`. [IALC.10.1] catches a partial override.
